title: Kitchens
blurb: Painted and natural timber kitchens, designed for your room and the way you cook and gather.

title: Bathrooms
blurb: Vanity units, washstands and storage in properly sealed timber, made to fit your bathroom.

title: Cabinetry & Storage
blurb: Fitted wardrobes, alcove cupboards, under-stairs storage and shelving that make good use of every corner.

title: Furniture
blurb: Dining tables, desks, beds and dressers, made one at a time to suit the room they will live in.

title: Staircases
blurb: Oak, open-tread and spiral staircases, made to fit period cottages and modern homes alike.

title: Windows, Doors & Joinery
blurb: Timber windows and doors made for older stone openings, plus panelling, inlays and fine joinery.
